BR-LGPD.text:
[TODO-zh] {{controller.name}} (data controller{{#controller.document_id}}, {{controller.document_id}}{{/controller.document_id}}; contact: {{controller.contact}}) will use the answers to this form only for the purposes below, related to your interview on {{show.name}}: {{purposes}}.

To prepare better questions, we will also look at information you have made public yourself (website, social media, interviews and published texts). Everything that goes into the preparation material will cite its source.

We will not use or keep sensitive data (health, religion, political opinion, sex life, racial or ethnic origin, among others) unless you write it yourself in the optional sensitive-data section and tick the specific consent for each item. It is your decision.

The data is deleted within {{retention_days}} days after the episode is published; we keep only the record of this consent, as proof. At any time and free of charge you may request access, correction or deletion, or withdraw this consent, {{controller.contact}}. If you do not want to consent, simply do not submit the form: the interview can still happen without it.

EU-GDPR.text:
[TODO-zh] {{controller.name}} (data controller{{#controller.document_id}}, {{controller.document_id}}{{/controller.document_id}}; contact: {{controller.contact}}) will process the answers to this form based on your consent, only for: {{purposes}}.

We will also look at information you have made publicly accessible (website, social media, interviews, published texts), always citing the source.

Special categories of data (health, religion, political opinion, sex life, racial or ethnic origin, among others) are processed only if you write them in the optional section and give explicit consent for each item.

The data is deleted within {{retention_days}} days after the episode is published. You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and you may withdraw consent at any time ({{controller.contact}}) without affecting processing already carried out. You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

ack.v1: [TODO-zh] I have read the alerts above. I understand the plugin only recommends: the decision to go against the recommendation is mine, and the editorial and legal responsibility for what is recorded and published is mine (or of whom I represent), not the plugin's nor its authors'.

alerts.R-CLAIM-CONDUTA-FONTES: [TODO-zh] This statement about someone's conduct lacks the recommended backing (verified status with 1 primary source or 2 independent press sources). Using it on air may create defamation liability.
alerts.R-CLAIM-CONDUTA-INDEPENDENCIA: [TODO-zh] The press sources for this conduct statement may not be independent (same domain, author or agency). Check author, outlet and agency before deciding.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-GATE-PENDENTE: [TODO-zh] The @guardian review (fact-check) has not been done yet for a mode that recommends it before recording.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-GATE-AJUSTES: [TODO-zh] The @guardian recommended adjustments that are not recorded as applied.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-GATE-VETADO: [TODO-zh] The @guardian recommended NOT recording this script as is. Recording against that recommendation is your decision and your responsibility.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-CONTRADITORIO: [TODO-zh] This mode recommends hearing the named party before recording, and no right-of-reply request is recorded.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-REVISAO-JURIDICA: [TODO-zh] This mode carries high legal risk and the recommended human legal review is still pending.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-SEM-LASTRO: [TODO-zh] Some factual statements have no dossier claim nor source. Saying unbacked things on air is your editorial risk.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-INFERENCIA-COMO-FATO: [TODO-zh] An inference (hypothesis) appears as a factual statement. The recommendation is to turn it into a question or hypothesis.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-RIGOR: [TODO-zh] The mode asks for sources for numbers, dates and quotes, and this statement rests only on self-declared information.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-DEGRADADO: [TODO-zh] The dossier is incomplete and this block uses its statements without a caveat to confirm with the guest.
alerts.R-ROTEIRO-TIMING: [TODO-zh] The sum of block durations is more than 15% away from the target duration.
alerts.R-FACTCHECK-SEM-FONTE: [TODO-zh] The fact-check found no source for this statement.
alerts.R-FACTCHECK-DISCLOSURE: [TODO-zh] The recommended advertising or sponsorship disclosure is missing.
alerts.R-FACTCHECK-LGPD: [TODO-zh] Third-party personal data is cited without a clear legal basis. (Sensitive data not self-declared is not an alert: it is forbidden.)
alerts.R-PUBLICACAO-GATE: [TODO-zh] The episode quality gate did not recommend publication (REQUEST CHANGES or HOLD).
alerts.R-MEMORIA-ROTEIRO-PENDENTE: [TODO-zh] No script linked to this episode is ready to record (pronto_para_gravar). Recording anyway is your decision and responsibility.
alerts.R-LOCALIZACAO-REVISAO-HUMANA: [TODO-zh] Machine translation: review source and translation side by side (names, numbers, glossary terms) before publishing.
alerts.R-LOCALIZACAO-SEM-ACEITE-TRADUCAO: [TODO-zh] There is no recorded guest consent for translated subtitles and texts in this language. Publishing anyway is your decision and responsibility.
alerts.R-LOCALIZACAO-SEM-ACEITE-VOZ-GENERICA: [TODO-zh] There is no recorded guest consent for dubbing with a generic synthetic voice in this language. Publishing anyway is your decision and responsibility.

Synthetic content with candidates' voices is subject to electoral rules in Brazil (TSE Resolution 23.732/2024; secondary source, check the current text): verify the electoral calendar and labelling before publishing the dub.
